statBlock.name: Ettercap
statBlock.description: A hunched woodland predator spins webs across hunting paths and drags captives back to its lair. Ettercaps sometimes hunt alongside giant spiders.

sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. The ettercap traverses difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webs cannot impede its movement. It knows where every other creature touching its web is.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage. The target is Poisoned until the start of the ettercap's next turn.
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Web Strand (recharge 5–6). Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. that is Large or smaller. It makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature is Restrained until the web is destroyed. The web has AC 10 and 5 HP. It is vulnerable to fire and immune to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Reel. Choose a creature within 30 ft. that the ettercap's Web Strand has Restrained. Pull it up to 25 ft. straight toward the ettercap.

statBlock.name: Ettin
statBlock.description: This giant has two heads with separate personalities. The pair may bicker or work together. Ettins sometimes join raiders or guard secrets coveted by druids and Fey.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.
Battleaxe. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and knocks a Large or smaller creature Prone.
Morningstar. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. The target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
sections.Ettin interactions:
Roll 1d8 or choose what the heads are doing.
1. Psyching each other up for a fight.
2. Disputing dinner plans or battle tactics.
3. Judging each other's work while doing separate chores.
4. Seeing who blinks first.
5. Exchanging formal introductions.
6. Making a show of ignoring each other.
7. Adding complications to a shared plot.
8. Keeping each other from falling asleep.

statBlock.name: Gargoyle
statBlock.description: An elemental spirit animates a winged stone sculpture. It may wait motionless for months among statues or natural rock, or guard a site for the spellcaster who called it.

sections.Traits: Flyby. When the gargoyle flies out of an enemy's reach, that enemy cannot make an Opportunity Attack against it for that movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Gargoyle sculptures:
Roll 1d6 or choose an appearance.
1. A smiling cherub.
2. Rough stone that looks barely carved.
3. A patched sculpture with pieces from other statues.
4. A dragon with smooth, shining stone scales.
5. A horned fiend with a tail.
6. A carved pillar or lectern.
sections.Gargoyle camouflage:
Roll 1d8 or choose where the gargoyle waits.
1. Knots in the trunk of a huge tree.
2. Stone monuments in a cemetery.
3. Projections on a cliff face.
4. Victims turned to stone by a basilisk or medusa.
5. Carved figures on a gate.
6. Rubble among ruins or refuse.
7. Stalactites or icicles overhead.
8. Statues inside a temple or grand residence.

statBlock.name: Ogre
statBlock.description: Ogres raid settlements and waylay travelers for food and loot. They may join a band that offers meals, plunder, or a chance to fight.

sections.Actions:
Greatclub. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Hill, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark.

statBlock.name: Ogre Zombie
statBlock.description: An ogre corpse raised to haul heavy loads or smash through obstacles. It follows simple orders and keeps working after injuries that would stop a living ogre.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and Giant and cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Undead Fortitude. When damage brings the zombie to 0 HP, it makes a Constitution save with a DC of 5 plus the damage it just took. Radiant damage and Critical Hits bypass the save. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Otyugh
statBlock.description: This tentacled scavenger buries itself in refuse and watches with the eyes on its stalk. It can lure travelers close with gleaming scraps or telepathic bait.

sections.Languages: Otyugh. It can send telepathic messages within 120 ft. This telepathy is one-way.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage and leaves the target Poisoned. Whenever it finishes a Long Rest while Poisoned by this bite, it makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce its maximum HP by 5 (1d10). That reduction lasts until the Poisoned condition ends. On a successful save, the Poisoned condition ends.
Tentacle. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 13) by one of the otyugh's two tentacles.
Tentacle Slam. Every creature Grappled by the otyugh makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 16 (3d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and is Stunned until the start of the otyugh's next turn. A success halves the damage and avoids the stun.
sections.Otyugh lures:
Roll 1d4 or choose the bait.
1. Puppet shapes made of trash hide its tentacles.
2. It sings a song in Otyugh.
3. It sends a telepathic plea for help or promises a find.
4. It sends an image of a gem, a damaged weapon, or a snack.

statBlock.name: Piercer
statBlock.description: A young roper with one eye and a toothy mouth poses as a stalactite for months if need be. It drops on passing prey and slowly climbs back to its perch after feeding.

sections.Traits: Spider Climb. The piercer traverses difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
Drop. The piercer falls. One creature directly below it makes a DC 11 Dexterity save, taking 10 (3d6) piercing damage on a failure. The piercer reduces any damage it takes from the fall by 20 regardless of the save result.
